name: Adonijah
description: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy

points: Adonijah exalts himself, saying he will be king, and prepares chariots and horsemen to promote himself. He takes the throne to himself rather than receiving it from the Most High.

note.label: 1 Kings 1: A King Exalts Himself and a King Is Anointed

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
